_about: Pinned heads for the wild sweep.
Without these the sweep means `the last 40 commits, whenever you happened to
run it`, so its numbers would drift every time upstream merged anything and
the hand-labels underneath them would silently rot. With them the sweep is a
fixed benchmark: the same 171 commits, forever, on any machine.
Move a pin deliberately, in its own commit, and re-label what changed.
